body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Hyundai Corporation is going to present its several display product lineup at the upcoming CES 2007 such as LCD TVs and PDP TVs targeting USA market.

With stable A/S system and price competitiveness, the product lineup includes 32-inch LCD TV, 40-inch DID and PDP. Of those, 32-inch low-priced offering LCD TV has been receiving favorable response in Europe market. It will be introduced as the main item for north America market at the trade show.
